reviewNotes: Four branches from the complete seven-piece physical diagram Black Kf7/Be1/Nf2/g7 versus White Kh5/b7/h2. Only g6+ wins. The Bb4/promotion/Be7/Kg3/Bd6/Qxd6/Ne4 fork and alternate Bd2/Bf4 blockade preserve the win. The main fork’s final Kf4 reply is independent. Premature Ne4+ loses to the uniquely winning Kh3 reply; an independently tested Kg4 instead gives the win back to Black. Every intermediate result is checked, including both sides of that error.
